label: D36-fokus-siklus-hidup-operator
decision: Which focus should the next autonomous iteration of Anastrophe (iOS access-card app + Go backend, branch feat/r1-scaffold) build, now that card-registry enrolment (ADR-0031/0032/0034) and invitation enrolment (ADR-0033/0035) are complete?

candidates.description: FR-51 + FR-38: operator suspend, resume and revoke of a card instance via the anastrophe-registry CLI (audited, credentials follow the instance status, revoked credentials recorded in denylist_entries for later reader sync), plus a way for the app to learn the server-side status of its cards so cards show Ditangguhkan/Dicabut and cannot be presented.
FR-60: an in-app FAQ screen with per-channel answers in Indonesian and English, reachable from the Keys tab. App-only.
Fix the verified open backlog items (invitation minors, renewal test gaps, presentation overlap, BLE fragment length, flaky BLE test, monotonic audit time). No new user-facing feature.

FR-05/FR-10/FR-11/FR-12: the Release 'Tambah kartu' flow built behind protocols with mocked device registration and NFC reading; live wiring waits for FR-03 accounts, App Attest and a physical iPhone.

priorities: 1) Implement a currently missing P0 requirement that is not blocked by pending user decisions (ADR-0017, ADR-0022, DEVELOPMENT_TEAM), hardware (type H tests) or Apple capabilities (Sign in with Apple, APNs, App Attest). 2) Safety and security correctness under the project rules. 3) Verifiable end-to-end in the iOS simulator with the local backend. 4) Bounded to one plan of 3–5 tasks that builds on existing modules.
requirements: Implements at least one P0 requirement from the PRD that is currently missing.
Can be verified end-to-end in the iOS simulator with the local backend, without a physical iPhone, reader hardware, an Apple Developer team, or a pending user decision.
Fits in one plan of at most 5 tasks that builds on existing modules.
